title: Designer I Running Footwear - TEMP
note: Running footwear design; temporary role that may convert.

facts.summary: Six-month temp designer on PUMA's running footwear team.
facts.duties: Sketches, renders and explores color for running shoes, researches competitors and CMF, and joins sample reviews.

facts.apply: Apply online through PUMA's Workday with a portfolio.
